channel.title: Foundation Universe (new posts)
channel.description: Posts in the forum category "Foundation Universe" - Discussion of things relating to both the SCP objects and the "universe" of the Foundation as a whole.

item.title: apollyon class scps: Re: apollyon class scps
item.content:encoded: It's hard to paint all Apollyon articles with the same brush since they tend to go in radically different directions with their stories. Personally, I find the class more interesting because of the challenge that it provides to the author — you know, you're kind of expected to write to justify the usage of Apollyon, in a certain sense, which is an extra hurdle you put in front of yourself with the hopes it pays off.

item.title: What is the **out** of universe reason for discontinuing MTF Omega 7 Pandoras Box?: Re: What is the **out** of universe reason for discontinuing MTF Omega 7 Pandoras Box?
item.content:encoded: From what I've read, it was a good idea that was taken out of hand. We're trying to give it another shot with Alpha-9, but the key is, we need to stop thinking X-Men and more Suicide Squad. When I first got here and found out about these MTFs, my thinking was that it is very hard to contain all these things and if some are useful, use them, and if some are people who may be cooperative, make them earn their keep. The idea should be SCPs are being put to work because it's expensive to house and feed them so the least they can do is help when we need them, assuming they will help at all. But it turns into a Mary-Sue fest because people want to make superheroes from anomalies instead of considering SCPs as horrors first and a last resort to solve other problems when nothing else works. Omega-7 went off the rails and the authors put the rabid beast down, and if we are going to give it a second shot, make sure the writers know the idea is anomalies that got caught and are out on work release.

item.title: What are your unusual headcanons?: Re: What are your unusual headcanons?
item.content:encoded: My headcanon is that the Foundation is only the most recent version of the Jailors and they go all the way back to the Children of the Night who made Titania's Prison. They contain that which should not be, and the humans first effort was 557, the Ancient Containment Site, which actually contains 2317 Prime under the floor in room 501(the note sadid don't move the stone, and I think we shoudl pay attention to that note, if I'm right, you don't want to know what happens when the stone is removed), with 2317 being merely the back door, and 557-1 was 682. 682 is subordinate to 2317 and they were the orginal SCPs, the things which must be contained and have been contained since the beginning of time. The Foundation has just inherited the role and someday will likely pass on the role to someone else, but the point is, the Jailors are eternal.

item.title: Why does SCP-682 fear SCP-173?: Re: Why does SCP-682 fear SCP-173?
item.content:encoded: My theory: 173 was originally created as a guardian totem to keep 682 in place, like a scarecrow. I believe 682 has spent much of it's existence contained by the Jailors in one form or another, and 173 was one of it's first guardians from when early Jailors couldn't manage to keep someone watching 682 and made something to keep watch when mortals failed. Just stop to think about what 173 had to be in order to hold 682 if that's what it was made for, an when it was perfected, it scared 682 because that's why it really exists. It kills everything because it wants to kill 682 and will kill anything that gets in it's way.

item.title: What is the first scp?: Re: What is the first scp?
item.content:encoded: My theory: The first SCP is either 557 or 2932, or perhaps, more precisely, what's contained in them. SCP 2932 is a Thaumiel made by the Children of the Night, meaning it predates humanity and contained what were basically the first SCPs from prehistoric times. 557 is the Ancient Containment site, and my theory is that 557-1(the prisoner) is actually 682, but that was secondary, its primary purpose was to contain 2317 Prime, with 2317 itself actually being only the back door. I mean, did anyone think 2317-K was coming out that little door? No, he was sealed in under 557, the stone in the floor is the key to the seal and thats where he's coming out when the last chain breaks. Why 2317 was made, I don't know, but my guess it was either cultists who couldn't find the main entrance or Jailors who wanted to check and make sure SCP-001 hadn't already escaped without breaking the seal.
